purpose: Teach: レター/高性能/撮ら/商用/出所/明細/否め/バージョンアップ

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: お得意様向けのレター、文面、私も確認しますね。
lines.en: I'll go through the VIP customer letter text with you, too.
lines.style: Efficient but not rushed. Light uptick at the end—inviting collaboration. Brisk pace that signals this is a working check-in, not a casual chat. Professional warmth underneath.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。高性能の新サービス、市場の反応、ご好評です。
lines.en: Yes. The high-performance new service is getting a really positive response from the market.
lines.style: Straightforward, steady delivery. Slight lift of genuine satisfaction on 「ご好評です」. Even tone, no flourish. The confidence of sharing good news that speaks for itself.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: ポスターに、社員写真、撮らずに、イラスト、使いましょう。
lines.en: For the poster, let's use an illustration instead of actual staff photos.
lines.style: Clear directive without heaviness. Practical decision-maker's tone. Slight downward emphasis on the reason—she's already thought this through. Calmly authoritative.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。商用利用の許諾、社内、徹底中です。
lines.en: Yes. We're making sure everyone internally has the commercial-use permissions sorted.
lines.style: Reassuring report-back tone. Precise, like checking boxes. Slight emphasis on 「徹底中」—showing diligence without being defensive. Professional confidence.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 情報の出所、新人にも、確認の癖、つけさせてね。
lines.en: And let's get the newer staff in the habit of checking information sources too.
lines.style: Mentor-voice here. Warm directness, like she's thinking ahead about training culture. Slight softness on 「つけさせてね」—gentle instruction, not demand. Teaching-moment tone.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。明細書のフォーマット、改善案、提出します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll have an improvement proposal for the statement-format ready.
lines.style: Responsive and forward-moving. Quick acknowledgment, then the commitment lands cleanly. Steady, no hesitation. The tone of someone who delivers on what they say.

lines.speaker: yuki_office
lines.jp: 業界の縮小、否めないところがあるわね、最近。
lines.en: The industry really is shrinking, there's no getting around it these days.
lines.style: Quieter shift here. Thoughtful, almost to herself but letting him hear her think. Slower pace. Slight sigh underneath—not complaint, just acknowledgment of a hard reality. The tone of someone looking at facts straight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。アプリのバージョンアップ、社員向けに、案内します。
lines.en: Yes. I'll send out the app update guide to the team.
lines.style: Closing note—warm but brisk. Natural wrap-up to the conversation. Even rhythm, light on the delivery. The tone of checking the last item off without fanfare.
